meta.ref: main (Gator Day look, 172a231; masthead fix ebcc797; type standard 2026-10)

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground under everything: homepage, hub, article. Text on it: ink (18.0:1 day), ink-2 (8.0:1), link (11.9:1), orange-ink (4.8:1). Night: ink 17.0:1, ink-2 10.6:1, link 9.9:1.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised ground for the score bug's next-game half and sheets that sit on paper. Same text pairs as paper.

tokens.name: hub
tokens.usage: Ground of the hub grid (Latest, columnists, scores, chips). Text on it: ink, ink-2 (7.1:1 day), link (10.6:1 day).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Fill of a module card on the hub. Text on it: ink, ink-2 (8.7:1 night), link (8.1:1 night), orange-ink (4.3:1 night, flagged).

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Fill of chips, photo placeholders and the stat strip. Text on it: ink (15.1:1 day), ink-2 (6.7:1 day), link (10.0:1 day); night ink-2 7.9:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy, bylines. The default text colour on paper, hub, card and chip.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, captions, deks' support copy, excerpts. 8.0:1 on paper day, 10.6:1 night.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows, module borders, table rows. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Heavy dividers: the 3px rule above a second co-lead and under the section nav's active link. Decoration only.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Kickers, links, timestamps, the 'more' label. Day is Gator blue (11.9:1 on paper); night is the lifted blue (9.9:1 on paper).

tokens.name: gator-blue
tokens.usage: Brand blue, fixed in both themes. Fills the day masthead and the stage sections' base. White text on it is 11.9:1.

tokens.name: mast
tokens.usage: Masthead band. Day Gator blue, night the deep navy surface. Text on it: on-mast (11.9:1 day, 16.3:1 night), mast-sub (8.1:1 day, 11.1:1 night).

tokens.name: on-mast
tokens.usage: Wordmark and sign-in link on the masthead.

tokens.name: mast-sub
tokens.usage: The small 'MEDIA' under-label beside the wordmark; 8.1:1 on the day masthead, 11.1:1 on night.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Ticker ground. Text on it: band-ink; the tk-label tag text 4.8:1 day, 11.1:1 night.

tokens.name: band-ink
tokens.usage: Ticker text on band (18.0:1 day, 19.6:1 night).

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Brand orange. Rules (4px quote bar, 2px kicker dash, 3px active-link underline, 4px stage-bottom), the focus ring and the roundel ring. Never small text on white (3.5:1) and never a fill that carries white text; use orange-ink for that.

tokens.name: orange-ink
tokens.usage: The orange that carries text. Day: fill for buttons, tags and pills with on-orange text (4.8:1) and small orange text on paper (4.8:1). Night: the plain brand orange, which gives 5.2:1 as text on paper but only 3.5:1 under white text. FLAGGED: night buttons and pills fall below 4.5:1, kept exact from the live source.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Label on orange-ink fills (4.8:1 day; 3.5:1 night, flagged with orange-ink).

tokens.name: tk-label
tokens.usage: Bold lead-in words in the ticker ('FINAL', 'NEXT'). 4.8:1 on day band, 11.1:1 on night band.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Stage ground: the game-day board, the tunnel opener, the season band and the Magazine card. White text only. Day is Gator blue, night near-black navy.

tokens.name: deep-hi
tokens.usage: Lighter step on a stage section for scoreboard cells and hover states. White on it: 7.1:1 day.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Primary text on deep and deep-hi.

tokens.name: deep-ink
tokens.usage: Small caps lead line of the board. 8.0:1 on day deep, 13.1:1 on night.

tokens.name: deep-body
tokens.usage: Running text on deep (10.1:1 day).

tokens.name: deep-label
tokens.usage: Bold lead-in words on deep ('Latest'). 6.7:1 on day deep, 11.1:1 on night.

tokens.name: footer
tokens.usage: Site footer ground. White links only.

tokens.name: live-red
tokens.usage: The live-game tag and live dot. White text on it is 6.1:1. Used only while a game is in progress.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Barlow Condensed for headlines, numerals and drop caps. The front page sets headlines in normal case at 700; stage and hub titles are uppercase at 800. Display headings at 800 carry 0 tracking.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The masthead wordmark, uppercase. Fluid clamp(34px, 10vw, 44px) on phones; 56px from 821px.

styles.name: lead-headline
styles.usage: Front-page lead h1 in normal case: clamp(30px, 8.4vw, 38px); a long headline steps to clamp(28px, 7.4vw, 34px); co-lead desktop clamp(38px, 3.5vw, 54px).

styles.name: feature-headline
styles.usage: Right-rail feature h2; 700 at 30px.

styles.name: hub-head
styles.usage: Hub section title, uppercase, e.g. 'LATEST', 'GAME WEEK'.

styles.name: pull-quote
styles.usage: Pull quote in Condensed 700, navy ink on day, wrapped in orange quote marks; 38px on desktop.

styles.name: dek
styles.usage: Front-page dek under the lead headline; 22px from 821px.

styles.name: article-dek
styles.sample: A bold opening line the author sized as a deck
styles.usage: Article-page deck: Condensed 700, 30px desktop / 25px phone, no drop cap.

styles.name: latest-headline
styles.sample: Gators open practice to the media
styles.usage: Latest list headline in normal case.

styles.name: board-score
styles.usage: Game-day board and card numerals, tabular figures; fluid up to 84px on the tunnel opener.

styles.name: standings
styles.usage: Standings table text, tabular numerals.

groups.name: Labels
groups.note: Barlow Condensed uppercase with tracking for everything that names or acts: kickers, nav, buttons, ticker, byline.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Kicker above every headline; 22px orange dash before it. 11px on the co-lead row card.

styles.name: byline
styles.usage: Byline, uppercase; the date follows in meta weight.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button label; 14px in the masthead, 13px under 375px.

styles.name: more-link
styles.usage: The 'more' link under a 2px orange rule.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Section nav links, 44px tap height.

styles.name: ticker
styles.usage: Ticker line, 38px tall, uppercase.

styles.name: rail-title
styles.usage: Rail and module titles, uppercase.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chip label.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Score-bug and pill tags.

groups.name: Copy
groups.note: Barlow, one face and one weight for reading. Article body is 500; the front page excerpt runs 400 at 16px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The Gators were never out of it, and the second half showed why.
styles.usage: Article body, weight 500: 19px desktop / 17.5px phone (line-height 1.68 / 1.62).

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Florida won its fifth straight on a night the defense decided it.
styles.usage: First paragraph of an article, weight 500: 20px / 18.5px. It carries the orange Condensed 800 drop cap (4.6em, floated; 4.15em on phones, padding .07em .11em 0 0).

styles.name: excerpt
styles.sample: Short front-page summary under a headline.
styles.usage: Front-page body and excerpt copy.

styles.name: column-story
styles.usage: Columnist rail teaser.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Timestamps and read times, 0.02em tracking.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Photo credits and captions.

styles.name: cite
styles.usage: Attribution under a pull quote.

spacing.note: Named by pixel size. The page gutter steps 16 → 24 → 32 → 64 as the viewport widens (see layout).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a rule and its label; the hover travel of the more-link arrow.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a timestamp and its headline's meta line.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and buttons in a row; icon-to-label gap in a button.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap inside a list row and between a headline and its dek.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Padding in a stage row; gap between stacked lead copy blocks.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the stage board and the second co-lead.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Phone page gutter; card padding; gap between a photo and its copy.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gutter from 600px; gap between hub modules.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gutter from 821px; space above a pull quote.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Padding of a game-day card on landscape; large section gaps.

radius.note: Square. Corners are 0; the only round things are the columnist roundel and the live dot.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, chips, cards, photos.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: The columnist roundel and the live dot.

shadow.note: Flat. Rules separate things; the only shadows are inset rings.

tokens.name: shadow-ring
tokens.usage: The ghost button's 2px outline, in the text colour.

tokens.name: shadow-ring-deep
tokens.usage: Outline on the stage board's secondary links.

tokens.name: shadow-underline
tokens.usage: The active nav link's 3px orange underline.

border.note: Rule weights. Orange 2px opens a kicker; orange 4px closes a stage section and marks a pull quote; 3px outlines focus and separates a second lead.

tokens.name: border-1
tokens.usage: Row dividers, nav bottom, table rows.

tokens.name: border-2
tokens.usage: Kicker dash, ghost-button ring, more-link underline.

tokens.name: border-3
tokens.usage: Focus ring, active nav underline, second co-lead rule, magazine reader top.

tokens.name: border-4
tokens.usage: Pull-quote bar, stage section bottom edge, score-bug divider.

tokens.name: measure-wrap
tokens.usage: Maximum content width of every front-page section.

tokens.name: pad-phone
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: pad-tablet
tokens.usage: Page gutter from 600px.

tokens.name: pad-desktop
tokens.usage: Page gutter from 821px.

tokens.name: pad-wide
tokens.usage: Page gutter from 1100px.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every link and button.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Section nav height on phones; 56px from 821px.

tokens.name: ticker-height
tokens.usage: Ticker bar height.

breakpoint.note: Mobile-first. min-width steps 600, 821, 1100; max-width tweaks under 430.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Gutter 24px; two-column hub; long CTA label.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Masthead 56px wordmark with sign-in; nav links show; lead goes two columns; gutter 32px.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Gutter 64px; score bug hides the last-game half under 1500px.

tokens.name: bp-small
tokens.usage: The 'MEDIA' under-label hides.

tokens.name: bp-tight
tokens.usage: The masthead button tightens to 13px.

tokens.name: bp-min
tokens.usage: Score bug and countdown shrink one step.

tokens.name: ratio-lead
tokens.usage: Lead photo frame (16 / 9 on phones).

tokens.name: ratio-feature
tokens.usage: Right-rail feature frame.

tokens.name: ratio-video
tokens.usage: Video thumbnails and cover-art frames.

tokens.name: ratio-clip
tokens.usage: Vertical clips.
